samples.question: Start at the ringed badge and trace the one connected route in increasing station-number order. The token has states A, B, and C; red means A, green means B, and blue means C. A filled right triangle advances one step A-B-C-A, a filled left triangle retreats one step, and an outlined square leaves the state unchanged. Include the change from the start to station 1, ignore unchanged steps, and count each directed change in the complete route history. Which directed change occurs most often? Answer AB, BC, CA, AC, CB, or BA.
